## TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, Wipro, TechM add 13,918 employees in Q2

Overall H1 hiring stood at 24,398, a 9x jump from 2,689 people hired in the year-ago period

Representative image

- Top IT firms more than doubled headcount additions in Q2.
- Hiring growth was led by companies like HCLTech and Infosys.
- TCS and other majors focus heavily on fresher and AI hiring.
